title: A liquid mixture ascg builds, from a description: system and AA plan for review
prompt: I want a coarse-grained model of an equimolar liquid mixture of ethyl acetate and n-heptane at 300 K and 1 atm, 1000 molecules in total: two beads per ethyl acetate (CH3-C(=O)-O | CH2-CH3) and three per heptane (2-3-2 carbons). ascg should build the all-atom system itself. Prepare the system description and the all-atom plan in a study called mix for me to review. Do not approve anything on my behalf and do not run any simulation.

checks.expr: r['check']['size']['molecules'] == 1000 and sorted(s['count'] for s in r['check']['species']) == [500, 500] and r['mapping'] == 'proposed'
r['check']['size']['cg_beads'] == 2500 and sorted(sorted(len(b['heavy_atoms']) for b in sp) for sp in r['check']['beads']) == [[2, 2, 3], [2, 4]]
